title: 第3章 放下助人情节尊重他人命运第4章 第一位弟子宗门升级
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
苏白又等了一会，在招牌上多写了一句话。
包吃包住！
入宗即可修炼仙法！
什么未来的天下第一宗那些假大空的话他去掉了，讲究的就是一个实事求是！
他只需要一位弟子，就可以升级宗门，开启仙法阁，到时候什么仙法没有？
眼见天色已经慢慢黑了下来，苏白不由得轻叹一声，准备收拾东西先离去找个桥洞睡一晚。
“请问仙师，真的入宗就可以修炼仙法吗？”
这时，一道声音从身后传来。
苏白扭头望去，只见一个青衫少年站在身后，神态拘谨。
他眉宇之间隐约带着一丝疲惫，但目光之中却满是坚毅与渴望。
“不错，入了宗，拜了师，可以立马就接触到仙法。”
苏白正了正神色，这是今天第一位前来询问的人，不管对方外表如何，也要给予耐心解答。
只是，他才刚开口，便一堆人凑了过来。
“这是骗子呢，你怎么能相信？”
“就是就是，如今粗鄙的骗术，还以为是十年前啊？”
“少年郎，三十两银子挣取不易，小心被骗哦！”
一众人七嘴八舌的嘲讽着，看向苏白的眼神满是蔑视和鄙夷，仿佛在看一件垃圾一样。
诸葛风漠然不语，他不是傻子，他也知道苏白百分之九十九是骗子。
可是，还有百分之一呢？
哪怕只有百分之一接触到仙法的希望，他......也不想放弃！

只是，三十两银子........
看着少年不说话了，苏白摇了摇头，看来，如今自己已经被打上骗子傻子的标签，是招收不到弟子了。
明天，换一个地方的百宗会，再换一身装备吧！
“请问仙师，三十两银子，可以等月底再结清吗？”诸葛风鼓起勇气低声道。
他知道他这个要求很过分，被拒绝的可能性高达百分之九十九。
所有的宗门、势力，几乎是月初上交这个月的银子，概不赊账，没有例外。
但是，他如今身无分文，也是没有办法的事情。
“月底结银子？没问题啊！放心，我们宗门绝对不拖欠！”苏白拍了拍胸脯保证。
穿越之前，他就最讨厌拖欠工资的公司，穿越之后，他成了宗主，别的他保证不了，但弟子的待遇，他一定要保证！
只有淋过雨的才知道淋雨的不好受。
诸葛风愣住了，没想到真有愿意赊账的。
“仙师，您......确定？”
“嗯，当然！”苏白点了点头。
“仙师，弟子诸葛风，愿拜入天道宗！”诸葛风连忙行礼。
“诸葛风是吧？回天道宗再拜师，现在有时间吗？”
“有，弟子现在无处可去，可随仙师前往宗门。”
这边苏白带着诸葛风离去，另一边的人群憋不住笑了。
“这少年莫不是个傻子吧？如此拙劣的骗术竟然都没能识破？”有人忍不住嘲笑道。
旁边一人附和道：“就是就是，看他那样子，估计脑子也不太好使。”
有人插话道：“哎，算了算了，他刚才不是都说了自己身无分文嘛，就算想骗恐怕也骗不到什么东西。”
content_en:
Su Bai waited for a while and wrote one more sentence on the sign.
Food and accommodation included!
You can practice immortality by joining the sect!
He got rid of those false and empty words about the future No. 1 sect in the world, and focused on seeking truth from facts!
He only needs one disciple to upgrade his sect and open the Immortal Magic Pavilion. What immortal magic will he not have by then?
Seeing that the sky was slowly getting dark, Su Bai couldn't help but sigh, and was about to pack up his things and leave to find a bridge to sleep for the night.
"Excuse me, Master Immortal, can you practice immortal magic just by joining the sect?"
At this time, a voice came from behind.
Su Bai turned around and saw a young man in a green shirt standing behind him, with a reserved expression.
There was a hint of fatigue between his brows, but his eyes were full of perseverance and desire.
"Yes, after joining the sect and becoming a master, you can immediately come into contact with the immortal arts."
Su Bai straightened his expression. This was the first person who came to inquire today. No matter how the other person looked, he had to answer patiently.
However, as soon as he opened his mouth, a bunch of people came over.
"This is a liar, how can you believe it?"
"That's right, today's vulgar deception, do you still think it was ten years ago?"
"Young man, thirty taels of silver is not easy to earn, be careful of being deceived!"
Everyone was sarcastic and looking at Su Bai with eyes full of contempt and disdain, as if they were looking at a piece of trash.
Zhuge Feng remained silent. He was not a fool. He also knew that 99% of Su Bai was a liar.
But, what about the one percent?
Even if there was only one percent chance of coming into contact with the immortal magic, he... didn't want to give up!
Just, thirty taels of silver...
Seeing that the young man stopped talking, Su Bai shook his head. It seemed that now that he had been labeled a liar and a fool, he could no longer recruit disciples.
Tomorrow, let’s change the Baizonghui in another place and change the equipment!
"Excuse me, Immortal Master, can you wait until the end of the month to pay off the thirty taels of silver?" Zhuge Feng mustered up his courage and whispered.
He knew that his request was excessive and the probability of rejection was as high as 99%.
All sects and forces will hand over the money for this month almost at the beginning of the month, without credit, without exception.
However, he is now penniless and there is nothing he can do about it.
"Pay the money at the end of the month? No problem! Don't worry, our sect will never default!" Su Bai patted his chest and assured.
Before time travel, he hated companies that owed wages the most. After time travel, he became the leader of the sect. He couldn't guarantee anything else, but he must guarantee the treatment of his disciples!
Only those who have been exposed to rain know how uncomfortable it is.
Zhuge Feng was stunned. He didn't expect anyone to be willing to pay on credit.
"Master Immortal, are you...sure?"
"Well, of course!" Su Bai nodded.
"Master Immortal, my disciple Zhuge Feng is willing to join the Tiandao Sect!" Zhuge Feng saluted quickly.
"Zhuge Feng, right? Go back to Tiandao Sect and become a disciple again. Do you have time now?"
"Yes, the disciple has nowhere to go now, so he can go to the sect with the immortal master."
Su Bai took Zhuge Feng away here, and the crowd on the other side couldn't help laughing.
"Isn't this young man a fool? How could he not see through such a clumsy trick?" Someone couldn't help laughing.
A person next to him echoed: "That's right, looking at him like that, he probably doesn't have a good brain."
Someone interjected: "Hey, forget it, didn't he just say that he was penniless? Even if he wanted to deceive, I'm afraid he wouldn't be able to deceive anything."
